note: Example data: an invented online booking software company with invented accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. The two competitors and every other domain in it are invented too.
how_it_was_made: Invented by a script with a fixed seed. The responses block holds every row the run pulls; expected_output.json is computed from them by the SKILL.md method.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "competitor-keyword-gap" skill. Compare example.com with tallyslot.example and bookwren.example: which keywords and topics do they rank for that we don't, where do they outrank us, and how do our domains compare?

account.business: Example Booking Software, an online booking and scheduling app for small service businesses (invented example)

competitors_chosen_from: the discovery list (step 1); the user confirmed these two as business rivals
search_console_range: 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-26 (28 days, both ends included, ending 2 days before the run), country = usa
what_the_site_sells: the /features/, /industries/ and /integrations/ pages in the sitemap, with the names below
category_phrase_note: Rule 4 of the keep test: a confirmed phrase alone, or with only filler (best, top, for) or listing words (list, custom, directory).
data_pulled: labs_competitors_domain on example.com, exclude_top_domains true, limit 20
backlinks_bulk_ranks (rank_scale one_hundred) and backlinks_bulk_referring_domains for the 3 domains
labs_domain_intersection, intersections false, topic regex + rank_group <= 20 + volume > 0, limit 500, per competitor
labs_domain_intersection, intersections true, limit 100, per competitor
labs_relevant_pages ordered by organic ETV, limit 50, per competitor
search_analytics by query and page, country usa, row_limit 5000
sitemaps_list, then the sitemap it names (https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml)
not_called: labs_bulk_traffic_estimation: both competitors were in the discovery list, which carries the same numbers
